value.rationale: The model is a canonical pair of dense opinion communities joined by the minimum possible coupling. The exact law separates odd-size deterministic fixation from even-size bridge-locked oscillation, proves sharp four-round stabilization outside immediate cycles, and counts every transient shell. These are natural, previously unprovided invariants of the dynamics; parity-dependent orbit populations and \(m^{-1}\) versus \(m^{-1/2}\) probabilities are not mere relabelings of generic period-two behavior.
